daily_structure_suggestion.description: Read articles, watch video lectures, follow online courses, understand underlying principles.
Code along, solve LeetCode/Hackerrank problems (SQL/Python), complete coding challenges, implement algorithms from scratch.
Apply learned concepts to build projects, clean and analyze datasets, develop dashboards, train models. Document your work meticulously on GitHub.
Regular short breaks are crucial. Dedicate 15-30 minutes at the end of the day to review what you've learned.

monthly_breakdown.focus: Foundational Skills: Python & SQL Mastery for Data
topics: Python Deep Dive for Data Science:
- Advanced Pandas (data manipulation, cleaning, merging, reshaping)
- Data structures & algorithms refresher (focus on efficiency for large datasets)
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in Python for cleaner code
- Advanced SQL queries (subqueries, CTEs, window functions)
- SQL for different databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL for practice, understand syntax differences for others)
projects_exercises: Clean and analyze a messy real-world dataset using Pandas.
Solve 20-30 advanced SQL problems (LeetCode SQL, Hackerrank SQL).
Perform an EDA on a chosen dataset, visualizing initial insights.

topics: - Descriptive Statistics (mean, median, mode, variance, std dev, skewness, kurtosis)
- Inferential Statistics (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, t-tests, ANOVA)
- Power BI (advanced DAX, data modeling, custom visuals, report server concepts)
- Tableau (advanced calculations, LOD expressions, dashboard actions, storytelling with data)
projects_exercises: Build a comprehensive interactive dashboard in Power BI or Tableau using a complex dataset (e.g., sales, HR, marketing data).
Conduct a full statistical analysis on a dataset, including hypothesis testing, using Python.
Create a series of custom, high-quality visualizations using Matplotlib/Seaborn.

topics: - Supervised Learning (Regression: Linear, Logistic; Classification: KNN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Trees, Random Forests)
- Unsupervised Learning (Clustering: K-Means, DBSCAN; Dimensionality Reduction: PCA)
- Model Evaluation (metrics for classification/regression, cross-validation, bias-variance tradeoff)
projects_exercises: Complete 2-3 Kaggle 'getting started' competitions (e.g., Titanic, House Prices) focusing on classification/regression.
Implement a clustering algorithm from scratch (conceptual understanding, then Scikit-learn).
Build an end-to-end ML project: data cleaning, EDA, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and prediction.

monthly_breakdown.focus: Advanced ML & Introduction to Deep Learning/NLP
topics: - Ensemble Methods (Gradient Boosting: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
- Time Series Analysis & Forecasting (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM basics for time series)
- Training Deep Learning models (optimizers, loss functions, regularization)
- Basic NLP tasks (sentiment analysis, text classification)
tools_libraries: NLTK, SpaCy, Hugging Face Transformers (basics for NLP)
projects_exercises: Implement a robust time series forecasting model.
Build and train a simple CNN for image classification or an RNN/LSTM for sequence prediction (e.g., text generation, stock prediction).
Develop a sentiment analysis model on a social media dataset.

topics: - Data Warehousing (star schema, snowflake schema, Kimball vs. Inmon)
- Introduction to Big Data technologies (Spark/PySpark basics, Hadoop ecosystem conceptual)
Cloud Platform Fundamentals (Choose AWS, Azure, or GCP - focus on one):
- Core services for data (e.g., AWS S3, EC2, RDS, Lambda, Glue / Azure Blob Storage, VMs, SQL DB, Data Factory / GCP Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Dataflow)
- Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation - conceptual understanding)
tools_libraries: Basic Cloud SDK/CLI (for chosen cloud provider)
projects_exercises: Design a simple ETL pipeline using Python scripts to extract data from a source, transform it, and load it into a database/cloud storage.
Set up a basic data storage and compute instance on your chosen cloud platform.
Work through official cloud provider 'getting started' tutorials for data services.

monthly_breakdown.focus: Capstone Project, Advanced Topics & Job Preparation
topics: - Integrate all learned skills (data ingestion, cleaning, analysis, modeling, visualization, deployment concept)
- A/B Testing and Experiment Design principles
- Dashboarding with Python frameworks (e.g., Streamlit, Dash)
- Scalability, reliability, monitoring of data pipelines and ML models
- Resume & Cover Letter optimization for remote/global roles
- Interview preparation (SQL, Python, ML concepts, behavioral questions, case studies)
- Portfolio building (GitHub, personal website/blog to showcase projects)
projects_exercises: Develop a comprehensive capstone project from scratch (e.g., a recommendation system, a fraud detection system, an advanced business analytics dashboard with predictive capabilities).
Create a personal website/blog to host your portfolio projects with clear explanations.
Actively apply for jobs, tailor your resume, and network.

general_advice: **Consistency is Key:** Stick to your 6 hours daily. Even short breaks are better than skipping a day.
**Document Everything:** Use Jupyter Notebooks for analysis, add comments to your code, and create clear README files for your GitHub repositories.
**Active Learning:** Don't just watch videos; actively code along, experiment, and try to break things to understand them better.
**Networking:** Connect with other data professionals on LinkedIn, participate in online communities (Kaggle forums, Stack Overflow), and attend virtual meetups.
**Stay Updated:** The field evolves rapidly. Follow prominent data scientists/AI researchers, read blogs, and keep an eye on new tools and techniques.
**Soft Skills:** Practice presenting your findings clearly and concisely. Storytelling with data is as important as the technical analysis.
**Health & Wellbeing:** Don't burn out. Ensure you're getting enough sleep, exercise, and social interaction.
